rule_en: Zero conditional = general truths: If + present, present. First conditional = real future possibilities: If + present, will + base — never put 'will' inside the if-clause.
rule_bn: সাধারণ সত্য → If + present, present। বাস্তব ভবিষ্যৎ → If + present, will + base; if-এর ভেতরে will বসে না।

sessions.title: Spot the Error
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the wrong word, then choose the fix.

items.prompt_en: If you will deploy on Friday, someone will work the weekend
items.explain_en: No 'will' in the if-clause: If + present simple.

items.prompt_en: If the tests pass, the pipeline deploy the build automatically
items.explain_en: Zero conditional fact: present simple, third person adds -s.

items.prompt_en: If I finish early, I would join the evening review
items.explain_en: A real future result → will + base, not 'would'.

items.prompt_en: If the demo crashes, restarts the laptop and stay calm
items.explain_en: A first conditional can take an imperative result: the base verb.

items.prompt_en: Water boils if you will heat it to one hundred degrees
items.explain_en: Zero conditional: present simple in both halves.

items.prompt_en: If the client signs today, we will starting onboarding tomorrow
items.explain_en: 'will' + base verb: will start.

items.prompt_en: You will get an alert if the disk will fill up
items.explain_en: The if-clause stays in the present simple even when it comes second.

items.prompt_en: If he won't reply by noon, escalate the ticket
items.explain_en: A negative if-clause uses doesn't/don't, not 'won't'.

items.prompt_en: If you push to main without review, the lead get angry
items.explain_en: Zero conditional truth: present simple with -s for he/she/it.

items.prompt_en: If it rains tomorrow, the team lunch will happens indoors
items.explain_en: After 'will', the verb stays in its base form.

sessions.title: Choose & Fill
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the correct option or chip.

items.prompt_en: If you ___ the cache, the page loads twice as fast.
items.explain_en: Zero conditional: if + present simple.

items.prompt_en: If the API ___ down tonight, the on-call engineer will get paged.
items.explain_en: Future meaning, but the if-clause stays in the present simple.

items.prompt_en: What happens if I ___ this red button?
items.explain_en: A zero conditional question: present simple.

items.prompt_en: If we slip the date again this time, the client ___ happy.
items.explain_en: A specific future result → will/won't + base.

items.prompt_en: I'll review your pull request as soon as I ___ lunch.
items.explain_en: 'as soon as' works like 'if': present simple for future time.

items.prompt_en: If you ___ admin rights, ask the platform team.
items.explain_en: A condition about now or anytime → present simple.

items.prompt_en: If the demo goes well, we ___ the contract this quarter.
items.explain_en: A real future result → will + base.

items.prompt_en: Ice melts if the temperature ___ above zero.
items.explain_en: A scientific fact → zero conditional, present simple.

items.prompt_en: If she ___ the certification exam, she'll lead the next project.
items.explain_en: The if-clause takes the present simple, even for the future.

items.prompt_en: If nobody picks up this alert tonight, it ___ into a bigger incident.
items.explain_en: A real future consequence → will + base.

sessions.title: Build It
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the tiles in the right order. For speak items, say it out loud.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If the tests fail , the merge is blocked .
items.explain_en: Zero conditional: present simple in both clauses.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If you restart the router , the connection comes back .
items.explain_en: A general truth → zero conditional.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: We will ship the feature if QA approves it .
items.explain_en: First conditional: will + base in the result, present simple after 'if'.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If the standup runs long , I will leave early .
items.explain_en: Real future possibility: If + present, will + base.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: She will call you if the client changes the scope .
items.explain_en: The if-clause stays present simple even at the end.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If you heat ice , it melts .
items.explain_en: The classic zero conditional: fact, present + present.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: I will escalate the bug if nobody answers me .
items.explain_en: First conditional with the result clause first.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If the sprint ends early , we will clean the backlog .
items.explain_en: If + present simple, then will + base.

items.prompt_en: Say what you will do if your next deploy fails.
items.model_en: If the deploy fails, I will roll back and check the logs.

items.prompt_en: Say one thing that always happens if you skip breakfast.
items.model_en: If I skip breakfast, I get grumpy before lunch.
